subject: COVID-19 Remote Learning and Staff Pay Extensions
overview: The committee met remotely to address operational changes necessitated by the COVID-19 pandemic, including school trip cancellations and distance learning updates. The body voted to extend pay for all district employees through May 4, 2020, and approved new sexuality education components for the middle school health curriculum.

items.title: Routine business and meeting minutes
items.summary: The committee approved minutes from multiple meetings in March 2020, along with the approval of bills and payroll.

items.title: Ad hoc report request procedure
items.summary: Approved a new procedure to standardize how school committee members request specialized reports from district staff to better manage workload expectations.

items.title: Superintendent and COVID-19 health reports
items.summary: The superintendent provided updates on social-emotional support, Chromebook distribution, and recognition for departing Assistant Superintendent Kirsteen Patterson; health officials updated the committee on local infection rates and park closures.

items.title: Cancellation of McGlynn seventh grade field trip
items.summary: Approved the formal cancellation of the May 2020 overnight trip to Elton Jones Environmental Park with plans for full refunds to families.

items.title: France trip reimbursement
items.summary: Approved accepting a travel company offer that refunds all but $500 of the trip costs per family following the cancellation of the April trip to France.

items.title: Middle school health curriculum additions
items.summary: Approved additions to the middle school sexuality education curriculum with an amendment requiring committee discussion before teaching certain sensitive topics to sixth or seventh graders.

items.title: Prorated yellow school bus contract negotiations
items.summary: Authorized the administration to negotiate a prorated payment agreement with Eastern Bus Company to ensure driver retention during the school closure.

items.title: Old business and subcommittee referrals
items.summary: Referred items regarding school safety procedures and outstanding reports to the Rules and Policy subcommittee while tabling the document regarding the function of the school committee.

items.title: Playground and High School Vision advisory committees
items.summary: Approved extending the deadline for Playground Advisory Committee appointments and voted to defer the Medford High School Vision Advisory Committee until the fall of 2020.

items.title: Resolutions and employee pay extension
items.summary: The committee passed several condolence resolutions and, following an executive session, voted to continue paying all hourly and salaried employees through May 4, 2020.
